input.title: Add an accessible name to the site search input
input.rationale: The search input (<input type="search" name="q">) has no label, aria-label or aria-labelledby, so screen readers announce it without a name. The input sits inside a search form (role="search", action="/search") next to a "Search" submit button. A short aria-label such as "Search" tells users what the field is for. The visible "Search" text is on the button, not the input, so aria-label is the smallest fix that needs only an attribute change. Reviewer: you may prefer a more specific name such as "Search products" if that fits the site. A visible <label> would also be better for sighted users, but that needs a markup change this tool can't make.
